description: This PHP class file defines a migration script for a Human Resource Management System (OrangeHRM). It performs database schema updates, language string updates, and permission data insertions pertinent to version 5.6.0 of the software. The class extends an abstract migration utility and contains methods for schema modifications, foreign key management, language string handling, and data cleanup.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Class handling database schema updates, language string management, and permission setup for the OrangeHRM system's migration to version 5.6.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps including language string updates, foreign key modifications, schema changes for tables, and permission data insertion.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.6.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to the provided version.

methods.name: modifyAuthProviderTables
methods.description: Adds or updates columns in the 'ohrm_openid_provider' table.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance used for language string operations.

methods.name: removeOpenIdProviders
methods.description: Removes or modifies OpenID provider entries based on existing provider types.

methods.name: changeGoogleProviderURL
methods.description: Updates the provider URL for Google OpenID providers.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries based on language string unit ID and group ID.
